CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cruncharr is a self-hosted Crunchyroll downloader with an *arr-style web UI: Sonarr integration, a release calendar, download history, and multi-profile language sync. Multi-arch image (amd64 + arm64).
This repository ships the Cruncharr container template. For setup, documentation, and support, visit the project page: https://github.com/mediavybz/Cruncharr
